Chapter 616: Chapter 39 Martial Tao Rankings (Please Subscribe)

“`

“Just these two hundred million Merit Points, of which one hundred million… actually comes from Bloodline Cultivation Path?”

Lin Yuan felt slightly surprised. The Ninth Stage Martial Tao Chapter was valued at one hundred million Merit Points, which, although still beyond expectations, was within a reasonable range.

But the Bloodline Cultivation Path? This method of cultivation, limited by the upper bounds of one’s bloodline and peaking at the Seventh Rank without the ability to open up an Inner World within oneself.

Actually holds the same value as the Ninth Stage Martial Tao Chapter?

“Is it because of its popularity?” Lin Yuan pondered, the Ninth Stage Martial Tao Chapter targets a group, it’s for the evolvers of the Martial Tao Cultivation System, and it’s only useful if cultivated to the Ninth Stage Martial Tao.

...

Ninth Rank Evolvers? There are so few Ninth Rank Evolvers within the whole human civilization, let alone the multitude within the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, that’s all the life from across the Cosmic Starry Skies combined.

All the peak clans, powerful races, and so on, along with some unique life forms, loners, etc., spread among individual clans, making Ninth Rank Evolvers quite rare; but looking across the universe, there are indeed some Ninth Rank beings.

But still just some, the overall number remains limited.

But the Bloodline Cultivation Path… can be said to be a branch of the Martial Arts Evolution System, in fact, it could completely divorce itself from the Martial Arts Evolution System.

Just like the Body Cultivation lineage in the Central Divine China World, not only can the disciples of the Daode Immortal Sect practice Body Cultivation, but Devil Cultivators and others can also attempt Body Cultivation techniques.

“Even with its broad popularity, it doesn’t merit one hundred million…” Lin Yuan was still somewhat puzzled, after all, the Bloodline Cultivation Path wasn’t his unique creation.

Human Civilization had bloodline evolution families a long time ago, but their refinement and application of bloodlines were not as perfected as the Bloodline Cultivation Path Lin Yuan had summarized.

What concept is one hundred million Merit Points? It’s almost equivalent to the total Merit Points needed by two Eighth Layer citizens, and there are far fewer Eighth Layer citizens in human civilization than Ninth Rank Evolvers.

“There must be other factors influencing its value…” Lin Yuan speculated.

He didn’t know that in the original valuation by the three goddesses, the Bloodline Cultivation Path was only worth fifty million Merit Points; it was several Supreme Beings who forcefully raised its value to one hundred million.

It was to facilitate Lin Yuan’s smoother development.

Anyway, as long as Lin Yuan was a human Evolver, giving a little more meant little to them, no loss at all.

…

“My current total of Merit Points… is now two hundred and eight million?” Lin Yuan felt pleased, of which two hundred million Merit Points had just been acquired.

And the remaining eight million Merit Points included three million left over from the last promotion to an Eighth Layer citizen, and the other five million were Lin Yuan’s reward for killing many Ninth Rank Alien Races in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Even though he only killed avatars, those were avatars of Ninth Rank Alien Races, not much less significant than utterly killing an Eighth Rank Alien Race, let alone there was a special Ninth Rank like Hunyi among them.

“It’s a pity… after I killed Hunyi, those hostile Ninth Rank Alien Races of human civilization all gave up the many opportunities in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, hiding in some corner…”

Lin Yuan slightly shook his head.

The Xuanhuang Secret Realm is vast, many times more expansive than the World of Gods, and contains Spatial Layers far exceeding a trillionfold.

If those Ninth Rank Alien Races want to hide, unless Lin Yuan conducts a carpet search, it will be very hard to find them.

And a carpet search is too time-consuming; even with Lin Yuan having opened up over two billion Spatial Layers, searching at full strength during the hundred years the Xuanhuang Secret Realm is open, he could at most cover one ten-thousandth of the Secret Realm.

“Forget it, finding the source of that calling sensation is more important.”

Lin Yuan’s perspective shifted to inside the Xuanhuang Secret Realm; at this moment, his Taiyang Divine Spirit was rushing towards the core area,

Creating quite a stir along the way, occasionally attracting native life forms of the Secret Realm and resolving them with ease, taking away the “Xuanhuang Crystals.”

The present Lin Yuan, within the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, aside from human civilization’s Evolvers and those clan powerhouses following human civilization, hardly any Ninth Rank strong beings dared to approach, the deterrent force was too great.

Since the Xuanhuang Secret Realm opened, not a single Ninth Rank strong being has caused such significant influence. Before making a move, they forced those from peak clans to retreat, preferring to forsake many opportunities within the Secret Realm rather than risk exposing themselves.

…

“Right, let’s check the current ranking of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path…”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts stirred.

While still at the Eighth Rank, the Martial Path Evolutionary Path was already first in the Chikun Star Domain evolutionary ranking, and first in the Annan Star Alliance evolutionary ranking, with the Eighth Rank Martial Path overpowering a host of Ninth Stage Evolution Paths.

Reaching the pinnacle of the Annan Star Alliance.

Now that the Martial Path Evolutionary Path has reached Ninth Rank, and with just the Ninth Stage Martial Tao Chapter valued at one hundred million Merit Points by the three goddesses, along with the Bloodline Cultivation Path as its branch.

Lin Yuan was eagerly anticipating the true ranking of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

“First in Canglan Star… first in Chikun Star Domain… first in Annan Star Alliance… fifty-third in the Southern Star Region?” Lin Yuan glanced over the latest ranking information of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

“Ranked at fifty-third in the Southern Star Region’s evolutionary ranking?” Lin Yuan’s vision brought up a virtual screen, with the rankings of the Southern Star Region’s evolutionary path scrolling from top to bottom.

The Southern Star Region, one of Human Civilization’s five major star regions, spans an area calculated in light-years; countless evolutionary scholars, Ninth Rank Evolvers, Tenth Rank Evolvers, and even Eleventh-Rank Evolvers have emerged from its history.

Every evolutionary path that has made it onto the Southern Star Region’s evolutionary ranking is one of humanity’s topmost, possessing profound influence. Earlier, the Eighth Rank Martial Path Evolutionary Path didn’t even have the qualifications to be on the Southern Star Region’s evolutionary ranking list.
